_comment: The only file you edit to ship a new version. Paste the Cloudinary URLs here and the page updates itself: version number, download buttons, file sizes and the release date all read from this.
headline: A new look, built around the numbers.
changes: Redesigned around operation orange: the operator keys are the only ones that change what the next digit means, so they are the only ones that pull the eye.
Digits no longer shift as a result updates.
Every colour pair meets WCAG AA contrast, in both light and dark.
Animations stop completely when your device is set to remove them.
